propositions: The bridge today is hard-wired to a single JiraConfig.project and cannot synchronize multiple tracker projects against one codebase.
Multiple repos fetching different project subsets against one shared snapshot would each diff the other's projects as remote deletions unless the project set is store-owned.

Tickets must record both their source project (for outbound dispatch) and their associated repos (for store-level mapping); the project field is tri-state (absent=legacy, explicit-empty=never sync, explicit-key=sync there).

Multi-project inbound fetch must iterate all configured projects for base JQL and for all three enrichment passes (parent/comment/issuelink maps), merging results keyed by issue into a shared snapshot per project.

Outbound mutations must target only projects in the configured store mapping; the cross-project guard relaxes from single-project equality to set membership and remains fail-closed on out-of-set targets.

Stores transitioning from single to multi-project must atomically write both the capability stamp and the mapping mutation in one tracker commit, with older binaries unable to create multi-project mappings at all.
